name: Dungeon synth
lineage: Early-1990s ambient subgenre developed by Norwegian black-metal musicians as parallel-project compositions, characterized by minimal MIDI-keyboard-and-synth production evoking medieval-fantasy and Tolkien-inspired imaginary-soundtrack atmosphere. Mortiis (Håvard Ellefsen), Burzum's 1993-1999 ambient catalogs, Wongraven, and the broader Cold Meat Industry label roster anchored the canonical sound. The 2010s revival through SoundCloud and Bandcamp distributed-production scenes consolidated contemporary visibility.
